en: General Mayhem: The Killing of Brigadier J
plotEn: The documentary examines the circumstances surrounding the death of Brigadier Nofriansyah Yosua Hutabarat in July 2022 at the Jakarta residence of former inspector general Ferdy Sambo, head of the Internal Affairs Division of the Indonesian National Police. Through archival footage, news coverage, and interviews, the film details the initial cover-up presented by the authorities, the unraveling of the official narrative due to public scrutiny, and the subsequent criminal trials that convicted high-ranking police officials.
